summary: Leftmost-first compilation skips patterns whose prefix already matches an earlier pattern. Previously, those patterns were never registered with the prefilter, shifting its independently assigned pattern IDs and allowing packed-prefilter matches to report incorrect IDs. The fix registers every pattern before the early exit. The supplied reversal is unique at both revisions and restores the complete parent implementation file. Blocked on test selection: the fix adds no tests, and no detecting upstream test was established for the runner's default-feature command. Existing tests::search_leftmost_first::nfa_default includes relevant cases such as leftmost400 and leftfirst310, but their small starting-byte sets select byte prefilters instead of the packed matcher. Disabling perf-literal while retaining std is a potential follow-up configuration, which this plan schema and runner command do not support. No tests were executed.
